name: Mama Guard
shortDescription: Maternal health tracking & support platform helping mothers connect with vital checks, guidelines, and safety alerts.
problem: Pregnant mothers in under-resourced medical environments lack quick, offline-friendly medical guidelines and symptom logging capability.
solution: Engineered Mama Guard, an interactive maternal support simulator and patient portal. Built vital symptom loggers and guideline dashboards caching state offline.
techNotes: React, Next.js, TailwindCSS, Vercel Serverless Functions
nextStep: Refine simulated offline queues with a local IndexedDB store and implement SMS fallback alerts.
disclaimer: IMPORTANT SAFETY & PROTOTYPE DISCLAIMER: Mama Guard is a high-fidelity diagnostic simulation and interactive prototype built for technology verification. It is NOT a medical-grade or HIPAA-compliant system, does not diagnose or treat medical conditions, and should not be used as a substitute for professional clinical guidance or emergency services.
outcomeExplanation: Developed with strict offline-first loading criteria so mothers in under-resourced regions can reliably check wellness logs and maternal safety guidelines.
